items.q: How many days passed between my visit to the Museum of Modern Art (MoMA) and the 'Ancient Civilizations' exhibit at the Metropolitan Museum of Art?
items.gold: 7 days. 8 days (including the last day) is also acceptable.
items.pred: I’m not sure—your records don’t include a date for the MoMA visit, so I can’t calculate the number of days between that and the January 15, 2023 “Ancient Civilizations” exhibit at the Met. If you remember when you went to MoMA, let me know and I’ll do the math!
